subject: 📕 $club_name is closing
body:
Dear $student_name,

We are writing to let you know that $club_name is being closed and removed from the Students' Union club list. You are receiving this because you were a member.

=== THE CLUB ===
Club: $club_name
Category: $category
Closed On: $closed_date
Closed By: $closed_by

=== WHY ===
$reason

=== WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU ===
- Your membership has ended. You do not need to do anything.
- The club will no longer appear when you view your memberships.
- Any club events still in the calendar will not go ahead.
- If you paid a membership fee for the current year, contact the Students' Union about a refund.

=== IF YOU WANT TO KEEP IT GOING ===
Clubs usually close because nobody is available to run them. If you would be willing to take it on, get in touch — restarting an existing club is normally easier than founding a new one.

=== FINDING SOMETHING ELSE ===
There are plenty of other clubs and societies looking for members. Browse them under Club Management → View Available Clubs, or come and talk to us about starting your own.

=== CONTACT ===
Students' Union: studentunion@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Thank you for having been part of it.

Best regards,
The Students' Union

$signature
